reviews.comment: She is a very sweet professor, but her lectures are boring. There is a short answer part of her exams, which she grades toughly. However, I would still take her class again because she gives good feedback and is very kind. She is also passionate about what she teaches, and cares about her students. She also responds quickly to emails.

Dr. Over is a very sweet professor, don't get me wrong. However, she is SO incredibly boring. I play connections in between her slides, which you don't need to copy b/c she publishes them. Attendance is mandatory once presentations start, so get all your skipping in at the beginning of the semester. Go to to the test review, do work, and memorize.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Over is very kind and cares about her students. Her lectures can be a bit boring but it is clear that she is passionate about her classes. She is easy to access outside of class and is accommodating. Tests are not hard and her feedback is always very helpful.

She was okay to me. I just found her lectures really boring. Her lecture slides are just words on a screen. Her exams were graded tough but as long as you take good notes and go to the test review you should do well on them. She grades the essays easy. There is also a solo presentation that is a big part of your grade.

Although this professor was very kind for the most part,she lacked in her ability to explain things well.Her slides are very basic and boring and it's super hard to understand exactly what she means.She starts new things without connecting topics very well.Her exams are very reasonable and she's a great grader, but her feedback is really confusing.

This professor really loves what she does! She is very clear with what she is looking for and how to fix any mistakes! 2 essays, 2 exams, 1 presentation, and attendance make up your class grade! Very easy to make an A in the class if you go and actually put in effort. She is also very caring and accessible outside of class! Take Dr.Över if you can!

Prof Over is a good educator but she can be a bit boring during lectures. Participation is not required. 2 exams, 2 essays. Not a very hard class, but don't fall behind. Wouldn't recommend if you actually want to learn about poli soci. Easy residency class. She's very picky and specific in what she wants in her exams. She's very caring.

She uses class vocabulary so often in the lecture so make sure you know that and adjust to her accent early, or it will get very confusing. Grading wasn't bad, exams are both multiple choice and short answer response heavily based on the lectures, but she does a review the class before pointing out what you need to know. She posts lectures online

I honestly did not have a problem with this class, the 2 exams are free response and she is super specific about how you have to answer the questions and grades the exams decently tough. The papers are not bad, and she does not grade those hard at all! If you manage your time well and study well for the exams you will do just fine.

Professor Over is extremely passionate about what she's teaching, and it is very funny. She posts all class materials online and has pretty clear grading criteria. There are three papers, two in-person exams, and one presentation. That may sound like a lot, but it's super manageable. This subject is pretty interesting as well.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Great professor! Clear about expectations for assignments. Two written exams, two essays, one final paper, & a presentation is the only work required. She is also very knowledgeable about Social Movements & has experience within the field. Would def take again!!

Really great professor! She makes the content accessible even if you have no sociology background. Super nice and caring and willing to help you outside class. Really not a ton of work either. Two short-answer tests where you pick which questions to answer. Two short essays, short presentation and a final paper on a topic you choose.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Over was such a great professor! She is very clear from the start about grading critera, and very understanding about any trouble someone may be having in the class. Overall, knowledgable about what she's doing, and obviously cares a lot about her students. Her lectures can be a little bit of a slog, but no more than any other soci class. 10/10

Dr. Over is such a sweet professor! She makes class very understanding and helps you understand the material very well. Her class was intimidating at first but it was very understanding I highly recommend her!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is great at teaching and explaining concepts. She actually goes over the assigned readings and explaining them in class. Straight forward professor when it comes to grading. Exams are open questions and you can choose what to write about.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria
